rows.grounds: numeral element forming a compound with 'sahasreṣu' to express a large quantity
locative plural indicating the vast number in which the womb-mechanisms are counted
compound of 'yoni' (womb/source) and 'yantra' (mechanism/diagram) in locative plural
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: What is the extent of torment endured within the mechanisms of wombs?
premises: Beings are tormented within these womb-mechanisms.
items.inference: Torment is experienced across an immense multitude of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
